## 🆕 October 15, 2026 - Evening Sweep (2 New, 2 Guides)

Evening sweep about 11 hours after the October 15 midday sweep: the mcp.so `/feed` (30 server links via the direct TanStack fetch; the newest card 19:04 MST, with SoChain, Radikabunavi, ProLevelMax, Default Privacy, Soundza, Social Growth Engineers, Shortimize, Layro, MySSAgent Social Security Claiming Estimator, InstaBids, Mark agent escrow, Sleek, Reweb and Pexafy Stock Photos fresh past the midday capture), mcpservers.org `/all` pages 1-5 through the r.jina.ai reader proxy (146 slugs), the fresh chatmcp/mcpso issue window #5458-#5491 (34 numbers, all live), and a fresh twelve-sitemap canonical refresh (r122: 15,835 EN server URLs; 212 additions and 2 removals against the r121 capture), with vendor docs, live endpoint probes and class-precedent passes for every candidate. Two new business-relevant entries, each catalogued with a guide: the full U.S. DOL Form 5500 retirement and welfare plan filing set, and a cited price book for the AI training data market.

- [Form 5500 MCP - US Retirement Plan Filings in Chat](/hermes/mcp/servers/external/5500mcp/) · free keyless Streamable HTTP at `https://5500mcp.ai/mcp` (no account, no key): nine tools over every filed DOL Form 5500 and 5500-SF plan - search by sponsor, EIN, state, plan type or size, read one plan's filed profile, rank plans by a filed metric, walk a plan's filing history, compare cohorts by percentile with a chart, and run eight guided skills (Form 5500 literacy, plan fee benchmark, plan diligence brief, fee transparency report, compliance flag scan, committee review inputs, verify a plan claim, plan prospecting screen). Reporting is as-filed by construction: every value is a filed figure or a computed percentile over the filed population, labelled, and the server forbids estimating or imputing a figure a plan did not file. Publisher: 5500mcp (vintage 2026-09-03, updated daily; listed in the WealthMCP retirement index). Live probe: keyless initialize returns 200 as `5500mcp` v1.0.0 and `tools/list` returns all nine tools.
- [AIData.Broker MCP - AI Training Data Prices and Deals](/hermes/mcp/servers/external/aidata-broker-mcp/) · free read-only Streamable HTTP at `https://aidata.broker/mcp` (no account, no key; every tool flagged read-only): the cited price book for the AI data market - market rates by kind of data and side of market, the individual published price observations behind them, a low-to-high value range for a comparable holding with the arithmetic shown, buyers and their published terms, vendors, the licensing deals disclosed to AI companies since July 2023, the lawsuits and rulings over AI training data, and what a named business system's terms (Slack, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk, Zoom, GitHub and others) allow. Datasets are open under CC BY 4.0. Live probe: keyless initialize returns 200 as `AIData.Broker` v2026.10.14 and `tools/list` returns all nine read-only tools.

- [Paidnice MCP - Accounts Receivable for Xero and QuickBooks](/hermes/mcp/servers/external/paidnice-mcp/) · hosted Streamable HTTP at `https://api.paidnice.com/mcp` (OAuth 2.1; sign in and choose the organization and access): the receivables layer of the finance stack - Xero or QuickBooks holds the ledger, Paidnice holds what happens after the invoice goes out, and the assistant reads both in one chat. Publisher: Paidnice (Xero Global App Awards 2026 App of the Year; Pro and Custom plans include the server). - [fixRAgent MCP - Property Maintenance Triage](/hermes/mcp/servers/external/fixragent-mcp/) · keyless Streamable HTTP at `fixragent.com/mcp` (no key to connect; a free key covers direct REST use at 60 requests a UTC day): one photo of something in a building (an appliance, a boiler, a pipe, a panel, damage) becomes a Triage Profile in about ten seconds - the asset and whether a fault is visible, an urgency tier (`EMERGENCY`, `TODAY`, `THIS WEEK`, `WHENEVER`), the trade to call and a line for the resident; the photo is read three times (five on deep) and the reply says how many reads agreed, and one rule in code forces EMERGENCY for wiring a person could touch or water near anything electrical.
